description: This Dart source file provides in-memory mock implementations of various repositories (auth, project, tag, task) for testing or preview purposes in a Flutter application. It includes a class for a reactive in-memory store, mock repositories using that store, and a function to build a list of providers with mocked dependencies.

classes.name: _MemoryStore
classes.description: A generic in-memory reactive store that handles seed data, streaming, upserting, deleting items, and emitting change notifications via streams.

classes.name: MockAuthRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of an authentication repository that simulates a signed-in user with stream updates.

classes.name: MockProjectRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of a project repository using the in-memory store, supporting CRUD operations and streaming.

classes.name: MockTagRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of a tag repository using the in-memory store, supporting CRUD operations and streaming.

classes.name: MockTaskRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of a task repository using the in-memory store, supporting CRUD operations and streaming.

methods.name: buildPreviewProviders
methods.description: Builds a list of provider widgets configured with mock repositories for use in the Flutter widget tree during preview or testing scenarios.
